treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Austria and the Republic of Kosovo for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance, with Protocol (2018)
eif_quote: Die Mitteilungen gemäß Art. 27 Abs. 1 des Abkommens wurden am 20. August bzw. 28. Dezember 2018 abgegeben; das Abkommen ist daher gemäß seinem Art. 27 Abs. 1 mit 28. Dezember 2018 in Kraft getreten. || [Art. 27(2)(a)] with regard to taxes withheld at the source in respect of amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of January following the date upon which this Convention enters into force
source_title: BGBl. III Nr. 2/2019 (RIS, authentic): Abkommen Österreich-Kosovo samt Protokoll - English text annex

rates.quote: b) If the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends, such dividends shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident.

a) However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

(2) However, interest arising in a Contracting State may also be taxed in that State according to the law of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is the resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest
(1) Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 26 (Prevention of treaty abuse - principal purpose test)
ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Most-favoured-nation clause, Protocol point 2 (re Art. 11(2)): "As long as in any Agreement or Convention between Kosovo and a third state, tax on interest arising in Kosovo is exempt or taxed at a lower rate, this exemption or lower rate shall be applied automatically." Applies only to Kosovo-source interest; several Kosovo treaties (e.g. HU, GB exempt; SI 5%) provide lower rates, but no official notice confirming the resulting rate was found, so the 10% treaty cap is recorded. ATK summary table shows dividends 15% only; the text also gives exclusive residence taxation for company holdings >=25% (Art. 10(2)(b)). Kosovo is not an MLI party; treaty-own PPT Art. 26. ATK lists entry into force 31.12.2018 (conflict); BGBl. III 2/2019 gives 28.12.2018 (used).
unverified: Effect of the interest MFN clause (Protocol 2) for Kosovo-source interest not confirmed by an official notice
